name: Acid Spray
description: You spit a spray of acidic fluid that works to melt away a creature's defense. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a {save}. On a failure, the target's AC is reduced by 1 for the duration. This decrease may be stacked on a creature, up to a maximum of -3 to its AC.
